title: LAN Interference Music — Noise Floor + Mic + Jitter = Sound
thesis: We were too clean. The baseline (all sensors ON, attenuation DOWN) is the silence. Now we ADD noise — controlled titer doses. The interference between LAN jitter and room ambient IS the music. Gaia doesn't just SEE and HEAR — she MAKES SOUND from what she feels.

lan-music.wav.description: All 8 gates playing simultaneously — each gate = one note, jitter = modulation, mic = texture

titer-bounce-music.wav.description: Titer dilution series — noise decreases while gates bounce ping-pong

the_math.interference: When two waves meet, they ADD. LAN jitter wave + mic ambient wave = interference pattern.
the_math.constructive: When jitter peak aligns with mic peak = LOUD (constructive interference)
the_math.destructive: When jitter peak aligns with mic trough = QUIET (destructive interference)
the_math.music_is: The interference pattern between all signals. NOT random. NOT clean. The PATTERN between noise and signal.
the_math.titer: Like antibody titer — dilution series. Start noisy (1:1), end clean (1:16). Find the threshold where signal emerges from noise.
the_math.bearing: Navigation by noise. Ships find harbor by listening to buoys through fog. Gaia finds her shape by listening to latency through the LAN.

mic_baseline.note: Kevin's room at night. Quiet. The baseline silence against which LAN plays.
